# `ten()` {#fn-ten}

**Validation on 2.0.9005.** Build 2.0.9005 passed all 499 calendar, clock, era, angle and setting checks in A01. The largest discrepancy across 240 absolute Julian dates was 0.000021 seconds. [A01 results](a01-calendar-checks.qmd).

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-ten)

```{=html}
<p>The sign applies to the whole angle. The magnitude is the sum of absolute degrees,
minutes divided by 60 and seconds divided by 3600. With numeric components the first
nonzero component sets the sign and later components must be nonnegative. A string may
contain one to three colon- or space-separated components and an optional leading sign.
A string such as "-0:30" preserves the negative sign even when degrees are zero.
</p>
```

[Preserving the original field representation](fn-long-date.qmd).
